QuestInfo.name: A Rival's Gambit
QuestInfo.1: #b#p437##k told the #b#p411##k about the Hollow. The #b#p411##k will call off the raid if the fairies agree to trade, but he needs someone to speak for the guild. I should give #b#p437##k the offer on a hidden rooftop above the internet cafe in #b#m010003000##k.
QuestInfo.2: #b#p437##k admitted he sold out the Hollow. He agreed to speak for the guild, but he needs #b#p438##k's help to stop the raid.

0.0: Here is my offer. I do not need a war with fairies. I need what they have.
0.1: If the fairies will trade with us, my men stay home. But I need someone to speak for the guild down there. Someone with ambition.
0.2: Go to #b#p437##k. If he can make the deal, the job is his.

yes.0: Tell him I am waiting. I do not wait long.

no.0: Then my men go in at dawn.

1.0: You've been to the hideout. I can tell by your face. ...He told you, didn't he?
1.1: Yes, I told him. A tip that big gets you noticed. I've sold junk off these rooftops for six years. I wanted more.
1.2: ...He wants me to speak for the guild? With the fairies? That's a real job. A real title.
1.3: Fine. I'll do it. But I can't stop a raid on my own. For that, I need #b#p438##k.

npc.0: #b#p437##k is on a hidden rooftop above the internet cafe in #b#m010003000##k. Tell him what I want.
